from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-0ca5e336.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = {(r, c)}
            seen.add((r, c))
            stack = [(r, c)]
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); cells.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))
    # Move rightmost objects first; each rigid object slides right until it
    # reaches the boundary or another object in one of its occupied rows.
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: max(c for r,c in obj[1]), reverse=True)
    occupied = set()
    placed = []
    for color, cells in objects:
        shift = 0
        while True:
            nxt = {(r,c+shift+1) for r,c in cells}
            if any(c >= w for r,c in nxt) or nxt & occupied:
                break
            shift += 1
        moved = {(r,c+shift) for r,c in cells}
        occupied.update(moved)
        placed.append((color, moved))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in placed:
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
''')
